recipeInstructions.name: Soak the oats
text: Combine the oats and soy milk and leave to sit.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix the batter
text: Add the cooking oil, Equal, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla essence and sourdough starter to the soaked oats and soy milk. Combine.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the flour
text: Add the plain flour to the batter and mix until combined.

recipeInstructions.name: Leave overnight
text: Cover and leave the batter overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: Add baking soda
text: Add about 1–2 teaspoons of baking soda slowly, until you start to see a light bubbling.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
text: Cook the batter as pancakes on a hot, lightly oiled pan.
